Method of Attack: Bypassing Windows PatchGuard protections to hook malicious code into the Windows kernel, allowing planting of rootkits on Windows 64-bit editions.

Exploiting Intel Processor Trace (PT) feature by allocating a small buffer causing CPU buffer overflow and opening a PMI handler that PatchGuard does not monitor, enabling undetectable kernel patching.
Attack Vector: Using Intel PT feature to trigger PMI handler overflow and hook malicious code without PatchGuard detection.
Requires attacker to have kernel-level access on the infected machine.
